hero.headline: Hope Served Daily in Tongaat.
hero.subheadline: Since 1995, Missions Ablaze has provided nutritious meals and community support from our kitchen in Tongaat, KwaZulu-Natal. Your partnership fuels this vital work.
hero.badge: Serving Tongaat Since 1995 • Registered NPO & PBO

services.title: Community Kitchen
services.description: Hot, nutritious meals prepared and served every weekday from our Tongaat location, providing a reliable source of nourishment.

services.title: Emergency Food Parcels
services.description: Delivered to identified families in crisis, each parcel contains staple foods to support a household for several days.

services.title: School Feeding Support
services.description: Supplementing meals at local schools to help children focus and learn, partnering directly with educators in the area.

services.title: Volunteer Coordination
services.description: Organizing local volunteers for packing, distribution, and kitchen duties, creating a network of active care in Tongaat.
